glossary.力量: 每层力量通常使攻击额外造成 1 点伤害。
glossary.易伤: 易伤单位会承受更多攻击伤害。
glossary.格挡: 格挡会优先抵消即将受到的伤害。
glossary.消耗: 消耗牌打出后会移出本场战斗。
glossary.附魔: 附魔是卡牌附着的额外词条或效果层。

runPlan.archetype: Strength + Vulnerable + AoE: align both claws for a one-turn double kill
runPlan.bossPrep: 45/80, empty belt, no healing node left: block every turn, especially T3 Bug Sting and T4 Laser 41-49; keep both claws' HP equal, kill them in one turn.
runPlan.summary: Boss is next with no node to heal; preserve HP. Damage gap 19/turn, so race with Strength and Vulnerable while blocking every turn; align claws and finish both in one turn.
